contentText: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam said on Thursday there was no end in sight to a ​war that had already displaced a million people over the last month, as families fleeing Israeli strikes said they were exhausted by repeated rounds of conflict. Lebanon is entering the second month of conflict between Iran-backed armed group Hezbollah and Israel, which has pledged to occupy swathes of southern Lebanon as part of a "security zone" ​to protect its own ‌northern residents. FRANCE 24's Olivia Bizot reports from Beirut, Lebanon.
